_comment: TOOLS BY OTHER CREATORS that we point at. Curated in the CMS; git is the
audit trail.
THESE ARE NOT PACKAGES, and they must never appear in manifest.json's
`packages` array. A row there is assumed by everything downstream to be
ours: Compare() versions it, the updater fetches it, InstallerExt installs
it, `requires` is derived for it, and the removed-guard would demand you
declare it retired the day the author's link dies.
WE LINK, WE DO NOT HOST. `url` opens the author's own page in a browser.
Nothing is fetched, nothing is hashed, nothing enters the store. We cannot
pin bytes we do not control -- the file behind someone else's URL can
change whenever they like -- and putting one in the store would enrol it
in the update rail, which is exactly what this list promises not to do.
This file publishes on its own, not with a release: edit, run
`python packaging/upload.py --recommendations`, and it reaches every
install within minutes. That independence is the safety valve -- pulling a
recommendation must never wait for a release.
Per row: name, author, author_url, url (all required except author_url),
description, and an optional free-form category for grouping. Version,
sha256 and requires are REFUSED by the validator, so this list cannot
drift into looking like a package list.
intro: While [FNSTools](/#tools) packs a lot of goodies, here are some other tools I use frequently from other creators. Show them some love!

tools.name: TauCeti
tools.author: PlusPlusOneGmbH
tools.description: Preset management and parameter tweening: store, recall and fade between parameter states, with a dashboard, a cue list and a CHOP mapper.

tools.name: QR Code COMP
tools.author: PlusPlusOneGmbH
tools.description: Generates QR codes as a TOP from any text or URL.

tools.name: EssentiaTD
tools.author: Darien Brito
tools.description: Real-time and offline audio analysis as native CHOPs, powered by Essentia: spectrum, mel bands, MFCCs, pitch, key, onsets and BPM, and EBU R128 loudness. Windows and macOS.

tools.name: Embody
tools.author: Dylan Roscover
tools.description: Externalizes your network to files you can diff and version, and runs an MCP server so AI assistants can build and debug in your live TouchDesigner session.

tools.name: TDFam
tools.author: dotsimulate and Function Store
tools.description: Custom operator families for TouchDesigner: your own tab in the OP Create dialog, manifests, placement, stubs and in-place updates, in one component.

tools.name: Swaggy Bokeh
tools.author: OVVO Studio
tools.description: Physically based depth of field in GLSL, with bokeh, autofocus and a focus overlay. Drop in your scene camera, or composite a render with a depth pass.

tools.name: MediaPipe TouchDesigner
tools.author: Torin Blankensmith and Dom Scott
tools.description: GPU-accelerated MediaPipe in TouchDesigner, on Mac and PC with no installation: face, hand, pose, object and gesture tracking, segmentation and classification.

tools.name: T3D
tools.author: Josef Pelz
tools.description: A family of 48 operators for 3D textures: generate volumes, process them (filters, composites, transforms, optical flow, fluid simulation) and render them (ray-marched volumes, iso-surfaces, volume tracing), all on the GPU.

tools.name: Pathtracer
tools.author: Josef Pelz
tools.description: A super performant, well designed path tracer for TouchDesigner.

families.name: FNS
families.author: Function Store
families.description: The FNS tab in the OP Create dialog: FNS tools placed as one node each, with stubs for projects that travel and in-place updates.

families.name: T3D
families.author: Josef Pelz
families.description: Operators for 3D textures: generate, process and render volumes on the GPU.

families.name: STOP
families.author: Spiraldiver
families.description: Strudel live-coding as an operator family: wire operators to build a pattern across six groups, and the Strudel Master plays it.

families.name: FOP
families.author: Spiraldiver
families.description: A 3D and 4D modular fractal system, announced when it ships.

families.name: LOP
families.author: dotsimulate
families.description: Language, learning, logic and latent operators: agents, MCP client and server, and hosted or local models inside TouchDesigner.

families.name: GSOP
families.author: Lake Heckaman
families.description: Gaussian Splat Operators: load .ply and .spz splats and edit, animate, optimize and render them live on POPs, with a per-point particle system and shader effects such as bokeh, motion blur and relighting.

families.name: AML
families.author: Mickey van Olst
families.description: AI and ML on macOS: Apple's built-in pose tracking, masking and image classification, often on the Neural Engine, plus CoreML operators for depth, YOLO, segmentation, Stable Diffusion and 3D mesh generation. Free to download.

families.name: MCX
families.author: Edwin Lucchesi
families.description: Custom CHOP operators for modular audio synthesis: a polyphonic synth, multichannel CV and generative data, patched in your network like Max/MSP. Mac and Windows.

families.name: MOP
families.author: Ilgın İçözü
families.description: A modular synthesis toolkit built inside TouchDesigner: oscillators, filters, envelopes, sequencers, effects and semi-modular instruments that patch together like Eurorack modules.

families.name: L2D
families.author: Prismatic
families.description: Real-time 2D lighting from textures: geometry, materials, lights and renderers in screen space, with SDF raymarching for volumetric global illumination, shadows, refraction and dispersion. Windows and macOS.
